description: Current behavior on a narrow screen: the opened option list starts outside the window, so the first characters of every row (group labels, the highlighted selected row, the rest of the options) are cut off by the edge of the screen and cannot be reached. The row that is wider than the screen is the one that triggers it.

Expected behavior in the same situation: the option list sits inside the screen with a small gutter at its starting edge, every row is readable from its first character, the over-long row is cut off at the far edge instead, and the long list still scrolls vertically.
